measured_from: DataHive Italian Conversations sample, all 6 stereo files (caller left, callee right). Distributions below are empirical samples from the energy VAD, not hand-picked targets.
backchannel_cutoff_rule: valley in the histogram of regions with overlap ratio >= the configured threshold, bin 0.10s, cutoff 2.750s (2929 regions)

calibration_to_datahive_card.cutoff_rule: valley in the histogram of regions with overlap ratio >= the configured threshold, bin 0.10s, cutoff 2.750s (2929 regions)
calibration_to_datahive_card.note: error is the mean over the six files of |turns/min error| / card turns/min + |overlap percentage-point error| / 100 + |median gap error| / 500 ms. Card figures are DataHive's own automatic labels.
